images.why: Caption identifies a digitally colourised thin-section TEM of a single measles virion, showing its nucleocapsid, envelope and surface projections. Strong focal subject for a near-square crop. This verified direct URL is the lower-resolution preview; the page lists a 28.33 MB original, but its direct URL and pixel dimensions could not be verified.
